title: Recommendation Request
description: The input parameters for generating music recommendations.

taste_profile_path.description: Path to the taste profile JSON file.

mood_score.description: User's current mood. -2 = very dark/melancholic, -1 = calm/sad, 0 = neutral, +1 = energetic/bright, +2 = euphoric/danceable.

task.description: The use-case the user wants music for.

novelty_level.description: How far from the user's usual taste. 1 = Only similar, 2 = Slightly new, 3 = Balanced, 4 = More experimental, 5 = Surprise me.

max_recommendations.description: Maximum number of recommendations to return.

include_familiar.description: If true, tracks the user already knows may be recommended; otherwise known tracks are penalized/removed.

genre_constraints.description: Optional deep-genre direction. When all selection lists are empty and no exclusions are set, genre constraints are inactive and scoring behaves as taste/mood/task only.
